key_insight: CommerceGen-Studio turns messy SKU metadata into commercial-grade main images through a structured three-stage pipeline. Its core idea is to combine iterative vision-language refinement with multi-condition generation so e-commerce images are both faithful to the product and optimized for selling.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the difficulty of generating high-quality, market-ready product main images from heterogeneous and incomplete e-commerce SKU data. Existing workflows often require manual prompt engineering and struggle to preserve product details, layout quality, and commercial appeal at scale.
method: Uses a three-stage pipeline: information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition image generation.
Introduces PERL-Agent, a Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop system where VLM and LLM roles iteratively convert SKU metadata into concise selling-point text lists using a reference-free rubric.
Applies a layout-oriented generation module to produce final main images conditioned on the rewritten semantics and product constraints.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this framework shows how to move from raw product metadata to production-ready visual content with less manual intervention. It is especially relevant for applied generative AI systems that need controllability, consistency, and commercial quality in real-world deployments.

paper_title: CommerceGen-Studio: An End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main-Image Generation
